fact: The INS Annuaire statistique 2022, edition December 2023, publishes administrative statistics from the ministry of health SNIS, education BSD school returns (pre-university, NAFA centres), INS external trade sub-directorate (customs), national road police and road safety directorates, the Caisse nationale de sécurité sociale, the central bank (BCRG), the investment promotion agency APIP, and port, water and meteorology services; it is an earlier edition of the yearbook whose 2024 edition appeared in October 2025.
title: Annuaire statistique 2022
